title: The diagonal circle acts faithfully and has a primitive full-carrier charge lattice

faithful_spectrum.restricted_kernel: ker(D acting on K/M)=D intersection core_K(M)=D intersection Z(K)={1}.
faithful_spectrum.hilbert_faithfulness: The D action on H_ps=L2(K/M) is faithful because the complete quasi-regular K kernel is Z(K).
faithful_spectrum.integer_spectrum: The 2 pi-periodic unitary D representation decomposes into integer charge spaces H_q(D).
faithful_spectrum.gcd_kernel: If the gcd of all occurring D charges were d>1, rotation by 2 pi/d would be a nontrivial kernel element.
faithful_spectrum.odd_charge: A gcd-one integer charge set contains at least one odd charge.

claim_ceiling: The complete spherical carrier has a primitive charge lattice for D and therefore some odd D charge. This existence result does not identify a physical K-type, multiplicity or particle charge.
